messages:
katie: Heads up — opened a PR to clarify how audit-log events map to customer consent flags. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5829. Need SOC2-friendly phrasing for retention TTL and a clear mapping table. cc @legal-alex @omar

omar: Thanks — skimmed the diff. Two quick asks: 1) make the 'consent' vs 'processing' distinction explicit; 2) include a pseudonymized event example. Also there’s a small broken link in the SDK snippet.

legal-alex: Ping — happy to redline. Prefer the phrase 'tenant-controlled retention' instead of 'customer-managed TTL' for SOC2 clarity. Also avoid vague 'delete on request' language; use 'support subject access requests and legal holds' instead.

jin: Working on the SDK snippet. Current python example shows `client.audit.export(...)` but we should include the `include_pseudonym=True` flag. Proposed snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.audit.export(tenant_id='t-123', include_pseudonym=True, retention='30d')
```

marco: Small nit — retention values should be normalized to ISO durations in the docs (e.g., 'P30D') per our API style guide. We should sync with backend to make which form is canonical.

samir: @jin @marco if backend expects ISO, let's show both forms in the example: human-friendly '30d' and ISO 'P30D', and note which is preferred and why.

katie: Good call. @docs-bot can you run a linkcheck on the PR when ready? Also we need an inline example for KMS usage via env var (example for customer-managed keys).

docs-bot: Linkcheck queued for PR #5829 — results will appear in the checks once CI runs. :gear:

omar: Also add a short migration blurb: customers using the old `/audit/logs/export` endpoint should map to `client.audit.export(...)` and set `preserve_ticket_id=False` to drop PII. Small diff below.

omar: ```diff
- /audit/logs/export?tenant=...&keep_ticket=true
+ client.audit.export(tenant_id='...', preserve_ticket_id=False)
```

katie: @legal-alex can you confirm wording around 'access logs' vs 'audit logs'? We should avoid mixing terms in SOC2 docs.

legal-alex: Confirmed — use 'audit logs' for security/process events (user actions, permission changes); reserve 'access logs' for infra-level HTTP/access proxies. I'll add a margin note and suggested wording.

jin: Updated the snippet and pushed to the PR branch. Also fixed the broken SDK link — it was pointing to v0.4, updated to v0.6.

samir: Quick QA request: can someone add a tiny unit-test snippet for retention parsing? Example: `assert parse_retention('30d') == 'P30D'` — helps catch docs/backcompat issues.

marco: Adding to the docs checklist in the PR description: 1) legal wording redline 2) sample cURL + py + go snippets 3) linkcheck pass 4) migration note 5) changelog entry.

katie: Perfect. I can add the cURL and Go snippets tomorrow. Target merge EOD Friday if legal sign-off arrives.

docs-bot: Reminder: PR #5829 labeled docs-soc2 and needs 2 approvals before merge.
